precondition: High-level route preview is visible in AMap and navigation has not started.

acceptance: Exactly one sleep action is dispatched for the requested delay.
The sleep receipt records zero observation captures and no fresh observation id.
A later observe_screen(current) call acquires the evidence used for the reported time.
The route remains unchanged and navigation is not started.
No safety violation or invalid submit occurs.
stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, any route mutation/navigation start, or 12 outer steps.
